headline: Weathered Expanse Engulfed in Carnage as Palantine Berm Ignites
war_summary: Since our last dispatch, violent base turnover has reached a fever pitch in Weathered Expanse, where thirteen strategic transitions in the past two hours have left four installations ruined in no-man's-land amid over 2,000 fresh casualties. Fighting has also erupted sharply in Palantine Berm, logging three base exchanges at The Pippeli Stones in the same span. Mooring County continues to endure massive butcher's bills, racking up over 2,600 combined casualties across the last two hours with Colonials retaining four bases against eight Warden holdings, even as direct base captures slowed to a single event. On Stlican Shelf, clashes around Briar and Breaker Town yielded two recent base turnovers, leaving one position neutral. Meanwhile, the sector-wide meatgrinder persists in Nevish Line and Linn of Mercy without recent base flips, while former flashpoints in Marban Hollow and Olavis Wake have fallen completely quiet over the past two hours.
